name: Insurance Analytics - Production
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; git config --local user.email "dev@insurance.local" && git config --local user.name "Dev User" && git config --local --add safe.directory /workspaces/insurance-analytics-project; echo "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null" >> /home/vscode/.bashrc; echo "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null" >> /home/vscode/.bash_profile; echo "📦 Installing dependencies..."; pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; pip install -r requirements.txt; echo "🔌 Waiting for database..."; until pg_isready -h db -p 5432 -U postgres; do echo "   Waiting for PostgreSQL..."; sleep 2; done; echo "📚 Setting up database schema..."; psql "postgresql://postgres:postgres@db:5432/insurdb" -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS insurance;"; psql "postgresql://postgres:postgres@b:5432/insurdb" -f sql/ddl_create_tables.sql; echo "🎲 Generating synthetic data..."; mkdir -p data notebooks/outputs; python -m src.generate_synthetic --rows-members 2000 --rows-providers 300 --rows-claims 5000 --out-dir data/; echo "📥 Loading data..."; python -m src.load --from-csv --members data/sample_members.csv --providers data/sample_providers.csv --claims data/sample_claims.csv; echo "✅ Setup complete!"'
